fieldName.description: The actual fieldName of what's being filtered

displayName.description: The displayed name of what's being filtered

valueType.description:
The different valueTypes of the field we are filtering on

datetime - will have a {@link UiSdlDateTimeInputFormDataGrid} cell to apply a datetime filter

number - will have a {@link UiSdlTextInputFormDataGrid} cell to apply a number filter

string - will have a {@link UiSdlTextInputFormDataGrid} cell to apply a string filter

category - will have a {@link UiSdlSelectInputFormDataGrid} cell to apply a categorical filter

id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description: The specification used for retrieving data displayed in the dropdown.

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

submittable.description: Flag to indicate whether the component should dispatch an INPUT_SUBMIT action upon input change.

value.description: The value of this input component.

invalid.description:
Whether this input is invalid.
This is necessary for when the state of the component is not managed by its container.

options.description: Holds the data to display in the dropdown.

clear.description: Whether the dropdown can be cleared.

field.description: If used in a form or filter panel, the field this component is associated with.

fluid.description: Whether the dropdown will take the full width of its parent.

placeholder.description: Content to appear in the input when the input is empty.

valueField.description: The field used for the values of the dropdown options.

selectedInputItems.description: The selected input items of this component.

displayField.description: The field used for the display text of the dropdown options.

search.description: The flag to make the dropdown searchable.

multiple.description: The flag to disallow multiple options to be selected.

showMultipleSearchIcon.description: The flag to display a search icon for multiple search dropdown inputs.

required.description: Whether or not this input is required.

title:
Filter option for a fixed list of categories. The filter value will be
a {@link UiSdlSelectInput} component.
name: CategoricalPopupFilterOption
